title: FlightHub: The Montreal-Based Online Travel Agency Behind Many Canadian Flight Bookings

body:
FlightHub is an online travel agency headquartered in Montreal, Canada, that sells airline tickets, hotels and car rentals. Company profiles say it was founded in 2012 by Matthew Keezer and operates as a subsidiary of Momentum Ventures, and that it has facilitated more than 30 million connections between travellers and travel suppliers.

An agency, not an airline

When you buy a flight through an agency, the airline operates the trip and the agency sells and services the ticket. That affects what you do when plans change: some changes can be made through the agency, while refunds and schedule changes follow the airline's fare rules for your ticket class.

Related brands

Reference sources link FlightHub to the Justfly brand family under Momentum Ventures. Fares may be the same across such sites for the same flights, so compare the total price including booking fees and any add-ons.

Before you pay

  • Check the total, including taxes, agency fees and optional extras such as flexible-ticket upgrades.
  • Note the airline's own booking reference after purchase and confirm it on the airline's site.
  • Read the change and cancellation conditions for your fare.
  • Compare with the airline's website and another agency such as Kiwi.com or Expedia.

What we could not verify

We did not book a ticket or contact support. Ownership and founder details come from company-profile sites and Wikipedia's article on its sister brand, and should be checked against FlightHub's corporate page.
